title: Binary tree — inorder traversal (Python)
description: Inorder (left, node, right) visits a binary search tree in sorted order. The traversal that makes BSTs useful for ordered iteration.
how_it_works: Lab exercise: type the snippet into a fresh file, run it, and confirm the test outputs match. Then change one input and predict the result before running — Recursion descends left first, records the node, then goes right — yielding ascending order on a BST.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Deep trees recurse deep — iterative with an explicit stack avoids recursion limits.
